newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Zinc sees rising zinc output in '97.
newsitem.headline: Korea Zinc sees rising zinc output in '97.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Zinc Co Ltd forecast its zinc output would rise 18.9 percent to 233,000 tonnes in 1997 from 196,000 tonnes a year earlier, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
The spokesman said the rise would be mainly due to increasing annual production capacity to 300,000 tonnes, probably from July, from a current 200,000 tonnes.
Korea Zinc invested 58.5 billion won to expand production capacity in the Onsan plant.
He said lead production was also expected to rise 35.4 percent to 120,000 tonnes this year from 88,600 tonnes in 1996. He gave no further details.
